title: Melrose House
geometryBasis: The exact detached museum footprint controls the main dwelling, south return and orientation to the park. Architectural projection sizes are derived from the dated postcard and the mapped span.
sectionBasis: The Sallo Epstein postcard records the sculpted twin gables, asymmetrical roof, glazed bay, pointed roof lantern and masonry chimneys of the historic north elevation.
limitations: The original historic house exterior is represented. The detached stable buildings are outside this model.
Wall and roof heights, gable details and rear openings are approximations. The 30 m source surface includes urban structures and vegetation.
